notes.title: Streak Mode Update Released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Presenting: Streak Mode![/b][/h1]

Streak Mode is a new way to play Bad Hop Baseball! Try to go on a winning streak and win the championship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/4d048d09f8732ce499a3e2d21f3160b20f0e08bb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/edbf179ad0b5cbb135114284b3c3f316de5f2487.jpg[/img]

[h2]Customize your team and select the game options that suit you.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/f5cbea4d3c5af784fa9e63567a6ed6928018fcf8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle for victory to earn buckets of baseballs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/c5eee77fdd0a0436bff45e43b0857c545d92d8f0.jpg[/img]

Spend those buckets at the Upgrade Shop to unlock and improve powerups. These powerups will give you improved control over the flight of the ball. There's still a lot of chaos at play, but with the right timing, it is certainly possible to land exciting skill shots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/9c03669bde0f1d305c17b4299f45555434c850af.jpg[/img]

[h2]Streak Mode Features 10 opponents of increasing skill. Beat them all and win the championship![/h2]

Thank you for playing. I hope you have some fun with this little game of mine :)
- Dectron Dan

notes.title: Streak Mode Beta Release Candidate Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi! I just wanted to let you know that the Streak Mode Beta 4 is now available on the beta branch. This is a release candidate! 

To enable the Beta for testing:

[list]
[*]Right click Bad Hop Baseball in your library and select Properties.
[*]Select "Betas" from the list of options on the left side of the Properties window
[*]Enter beta access code: betatestingpassword
[*]Select the beta you would like to opt into from the drop down menu. 
[*]You should see the title "beta - for beta testing"
[/list]

I would love to have your feedback! Join the Discord to keep in touch: https://discord.gg/3Ak2RewHP7

notes.title: Streak Mode Beta Now Available
notes.content:
[b][h1]Streak Mode Beta Now Available for Testing![/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/5ea79e1a5820973d55721a6237a2ae10244d23ec.jpg[/img]

Hi there! Happy Friday to you wherever you are in the world. I am very excited to share the beta version of the Streak Mode update. To be transparent, this weekend I'm off to watch a bit of the World Baseball Classic! So although there's clearly still cosmetic work to be done on the Streak Mode update, I wanted to share the beta now today before I head off for a few days. 

I'm looking forward to some international tournament baseball! Then I'll come back next week and push this update to completion :) 

[h2][b]To enable the Beta for testing:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Right click Bad Hop Baseball in your library and select Properties.
[*]Select "Betas" from the list of options on the left side of the Properties window
[*]Enter beta access code: betatestingpassword
[*] Select the beta you would like to opt into from the drop down menu. You should see the title "beta - for beta testing"
[/list] 
[h2][b][url=https://discord.gg/3Ak2RewHP7]Join the Discord! I would love to hear your feedback![/url][/b][/h2]


[b][h1]Thanks for playing![/h1][/b]

[b][h2]Streak Mode Overview[/h2][/b]
Streak Mode adds 10 computer-controlled adversaries of increasing difficulty. Your goal is to defeat them all before you run out of tries. Along the way, you will earn Buckets of Baseballs for recording hits and runs. You'll use that currency to acquire upgrades to give you a measure of control over the trajectory of the ball.

Upgrades:
- Jump
- Push
- Brake


In addition, to those ugprades, Pinch Hitters are now cumulative and need to be restocked at the upgrade store between games. As you go through Streak Mode, you'll have to make decisions about what aspect of your team to upgrade. Do you decrease the cooldown of your preferred upgrade? Or do you want to pocket another Pinch Hitter?

The Streak Mode beta contains only 4 offensive powerups and no defensive powerups. The plan is to get these guys out there in a good state first and then move onto the Defensive side of things. I don't have a concrete plan, but it would also be great to add more powerups and items such that the store experience is randomized as well.

notes.title: Announcing: Streak Mode
notes.content:
[b][h1]Introducing: Streak Mode[/h1][/b]
Hello! Thank you very much to everyone who has played a few games of Bad Hop Baseball! This is my first ever game and, more than anything else, I just want people to have fun with it. Smiles on faces. That's what this is all about!

[url=https://discord.gg/3Ak2RewHP7]Join the Discord if you'd like to keep in touch[/url]

I was very pleased to see that some people found fun in the the very simple and straightforward nature of the base game. I also see the feedback from folks who would like to see more done with the concept and I am excited to share the first look at what's coming next! Check it out.

[h2][b]New Game Mode[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/349f5752a03927399608b6c3bdf0cf30b49ed15c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Win Games[/b][/h3]
[*] [h3][b]Earn Buckets[/b][/h3]
[*] [h3][b]Buy Upgrades[/b][/h3]
[/list]
[h2]New Customization Options[/h2]
I'm building these out for Streak Mode but they will also come to Classic Mode and 2-Player!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/26465ed214f3a09587abbcd8cb6d71c5818b206c.png[/img]

[h2]At first, your adversaries will be pushovers[/h2]
But difficulty will ramp up over time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/126c8184917372b3416485f4db64fd3eca68b9fb.png[/img]

[h2]Victory earns buckets of baseballs[/h2]
You'll have to earn currency in the form of Buckets of Baseballs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/41557496daf5a849d5ead3c43be5cee7c301b157.png[/img]

[h2]Which you can use to buy Upgrades and Powerups[/h2]
These will give you a measure of control over the outcome of each at bat. The goal here is to introduce some skill and strategy into the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542693/671b2c761b97349f61d845947d0b6d0a9057226f.png[/img]

[h2][b]When?[/b][/h2]
I expect to begin Beta testing this update by March 9th. 

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/3Ak2RewHP7]Join the Discord and be the first to get your hands Streak Mode[/url][/h3]

These are the core pieces to the first major update to Bad Hop Baseball. I'd love to hear what you think about it!

notes.title: Bad Hop Baseball v1.01 - Launch + 1 // Improvements + Refinements
notes.content:
[h1]Holy Smokes![/h1]

I can't quite believe I've gone from zero experience to releasing a game on Steam and now I'm writing patch notes. Cool! Thank you to everyone who has played and offered their feedback thus far.

I definitely recognize that this game is a bare minimum of what it can eventually be. I really wanted to get it out the door and into your hands just to see if anybody even liked the concept. Now that you have shown me that you'd like more Bad Hop, I'm hard at work making plans to take this game to the next level! I'm going to be working every day so [url=https://discord.gg/3Ak2RewHP7]join the Discord to keep in touch! [/url]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

Now, onto the good stuff! I made some changes in response to feedback I've received:

[list]
[*] [b]Two Out Danger Cam: [/b] With 2 outs and the ball near the bottom of the playfield, the camera zooms in and time slows down. I've added a visual effect to make it clear why the camera has moved in.
[*] [b]Pinch Hit Refinement:[/b] I refined the handling of the text on the pinch hit buttons. Now, when you use your last Pinch Hitter, the text on the button will disappear (previously, it stayed stuck on "Click to Confirm")
[*] [b]Bouncing Ping Sounds Refinement:[/b] Overall, the sound of the pings from the ball bouncing is lower by default (NOTE: also you can tweak many SFX volumes independently from each other in the options)
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Bouncing Ping Sounds removed from main menu.
[*] [b] Tutorial:[/b] Fixed a spelling error in the tutorial.
[/list]

Lots more to come! I'll be working on adding to this game ASAP. And I made it completely from scratch in under two months. So imagine what I can do in two more months! Stay tuned and thanks so much for playing!

-Dectron Dan
